versions.provenance: Generic UICC/AJCC TNM conceptual framework used as a scaffold only. Breast-specific T, N and M criteria (tumour size cut-offs, node counts, biomarker/prognostic-stage rules) and the full anatomic stage grouping are NOT included here and require the licensed AJCC 8th Edition manual plus R1 clinical verification before use.

stageGroups.basis: Carcinoma in situ, node-negative, no metastasis is Stage 0 (universal TNM convention).
Small primary tumour, node-negative, no metastasis maps to Stage I in the conceptual TNM framework (exact site-specific boundary pending licensed AJCC data).
Any distant metastasis (M1) is Stage IV (universal TNM convention).

versions.gapNote: Intermediate stage groups (II and III and their sub-stages) are site-specific and are NOT included. They require licensed AJCC 8th Edition data plus R1 sign-off.
